config.masterattractor.title: MasterAttractor Configuration
config.masterattractor.radius.tooltip: Radius (in blocks) around the player to pull entities from (supports up to 2048 blocks!).
config.masterattractor.strength.tooltip: Force multiplier for non-item entities (mobs, vehicles, falling blocks).
config.masterattractor.tickInterval.tool: Run pull logic every N ticks (1 = every tick for maximum smoothness).
config.masterattractor.animationMode.too: Flight style: ARC_HOP (parabolic jump into pocket), SPIRAL (vortex swirl), MAGNETIC (tractor beam ease-in), FLOAT (gentle wave drift).
config.masterattractor.flightSpeed.toolt: Velocity multiplier for flying items (lower = cinematic and smooth, higher = snappy).
config.masterattractor.jumpStrength.tool: Initial lift-off jump height when items leave the ground.
config.masterattractor.enableCeilingClam: Detects solid roofs overhead and dynamically clamps jump height to prevent items hitting ceilings.
config.masterattractor.targetPocket.tool: Aims flying items at your waist / belt (0.75m) instead of your face for an authentic pocket-entering feel.
config.masterattractor.smoothArrival.too: Applies organic inertia blending to prevent sudden velocity snaps or teleportation.
config.masterattractor.instantVacuum.too: If enabled, items instantly transfer to inventory without flying.
config.masterattractor.particleTrail.too: Particle effect trailing behind attracted entities (Portal, Enchanted, Flame, Electric Spark, Glow, Heart, etc.).
config.masterattractor.trailDensity.tool: Frequency and count of particle emissions.
Spawns a subtle sparkle pop effect when an item enters your pocket.
config.masterattractor.playSoundOnPull.t: Play subtle pickup chime on attraction (throttled to once per player).
Plays a satisfying subtle pop when an item reaches your pocket.
config.masterattractor.soundVolume.toolt: Volume level for attraction sound effects.
config.masterattractor.attractItems.tool: Pull dropped items on the ground.
config.masterattractor.attractProjectile: Pull incoming arrows, tridents, and throwables (ignores your own shots).
config.masterattractor.attractMobs.toolt: Pull living mobs toward the player.
config.masterattractor.attractFallingBlo: Pull falling sand, gravel, anvils, etc.
config.masterattractor.filterMode.toolti: NONE = no filter, BLACKLIST = ignore listed items, WHITELIST = pull ONLY listed items.
config.masterattractor.filteredItems.too: List of item identifiers (e.g. minecraft:cobblestone, minecraft:dirt, minecraft:rotten_flesh).
config.masterattractor.checkInventorySpa: Do not attract items if your inventory cannot hold any more of them (prevents item swirling/bouncing).
config.masterattractor.vacuumMode.toolti: Directly inserts items into player inventory without dropping or bouncing on ground.
config.masterattractor.respectPickupDela: When enabled, will not pull items that cannot be picked up yet.
config.masterattractor.ignorePlayersWith: Do not attract if the player is in creative or invulnerable mode.
config.masterattractor.onlyPullToNearest: Prevents tug-of-war in multiplayer by letting only the closest attracting player pull an entity.
